metadata.title: Evan Yang · AI Engineering & Products
metadata.description: AI products and creative work for investors, developers, and anime, comics, and games fans. Selected projects by Evan Yang.

hero.intro: I'm Evan, an AI engineer and independent developer, exploring how technology can serve real needs.

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm based in Shanghai. I studied statistics at Beihang University, then pursued a master's degree in statistics at Columbia University. Since graduating, I've worked on AI algorithms, gradually moving from machine learning toward AI agents.

My earlier work focused on demand forecasting, operations research, and computer vision. More recently, I've worked on LLM applications, including model post-training, query understanding, tool calling, and LLM evaluation. Outside my day job, I build independent products to explore the full process from an idea, data, and algorithms to a working product.

contact.title: Let's turn ideas into products.
contact.description: I'd love to exchange ideas about AI agents, algorithm engineering, and independent products—or discuss a concrete collaboration.

logicduo.background: Investment information is scattered across news, announcements, and market discussions. LogicDuo brings information retrieval and LLM analysis into the everyday research workflow of individual investors, helping them organize information and research leads around the assets they follow.
features: Find information about stocks, funds, and market themes.
Identify stock and fund names from uploaded or pasted watchlist screenshots.
Start exploring from market trends and frequently used themes.
logicduo.approach: Organize search around investors' information needs, then use LLMs to help interpret news, examine reasoning, and support research. The focus is on information organization, analysis workflows, and the everyday user experience.
logicduo.title: LogicDuo

forearena.title: ForeArena
forearena.background: ForeArena follows investment targets through recurring research. Independent AI agents examine market information and compare perspectives, with traceable briefings delivered on a chosen schedule.
features: Choose official or custom targets and set a research schedule.
Compare market drivers, recent changes, future scenarios, and agent views.
Receive briefings in your account, by email, and through a read-only API.
forearena.approach: Schedule research around each target and its market calendar. Combine independent agent results while keeping sourced facts, scenario judgments, agreements, disagreements, and report versions distinct.

qimiao.title: Qimiao Productivity
qimiao.summary: Online AI tools and local Skills
qimiao.background: Everyday needs become focused tools that people can use directly. Browser workbenches handle online tasks, while selected capabilities are delivered as local Skill packages, building a reusable body of execution knowledge.
features: Find tools by the concrete task you want to complete.
Use online workbenches and download selected local Skills.
Track tasks, preview results, and download delivered files.
qimiao.approach: Tool definitions, recipes, and a shared runtime separate product content from execution. Task, file, account, and billing infrastructure are reused so individual tools can evolve independently.

genchi.background: Live-event information is scattered across artist websites, project announcements, and ticketing platforms. Performance dates and ticket-sale schedules are often published separately. Genchi organizes this material into a place to discover events, search for information, and plan a schedule.
features: Discover Anisong, J-POP, and other live events through artists and projects you enjoy.
Browse listed events and schedules by region, event type, and date.
Use multilingual browsing, guides, and connection points for AI assistants.
genchi.approach: Organize events, individual performances, and key milestones into information that can be updated over time, then present it through discovery pages, calendars, and AI question-and-answer interfaces. Keep sources, dates, and event details connected to help people move from an interest to an actual trip.
